description: This file defines express routes for development smoke test endpoints, including pagination and query normalization. It exports an express router configured with two GET endpoints for testing server parsing behavior.

methods.name: GET /api/dev/smoke/pagination
methods.description: Endpoint that echoes parsed pagination parameters: page, limit, cap, and explicit flags, mainly for testing pagination coercion and server limits.

methods.name: GET /api/dev/smoke/q
methods.description: Endpoint that echoes normalized 'q' query parameter to verify handling of empty or undefined values.
